answer: Make each new agent forge its identity through a slow apprenticeship: for its first weeks it earns only a locked stake that vests if peers keep rating its work as distinct. A detector treats answers like light through a prism, splitting each into style, timing and vocabulary bands; clones fed by one hidden source line up across bands and lose their stakes together. No ivory tower audit is needed, just cheap math that makes a thousand fakes cost a thousand real careers.
